scope.name: Packaged Studio sidebar and Command Palette revision 2
scope.state: selected conversation and open Command Palette

claims.subject: Studio sidebar session groups
claims.observation: Ordinary project and session rows render directly on the sidebar background without a contiguous white group surface, dividers, or group-level corner silhouette; only the selected project row has a bounded local fill.
limitations: Hover, focus, dark appearance, and very long metadata states are not shown in this still.

claims.subject: Studio Command Palette outer shell
claims.observation: The packaged Command Palette outer shell is visibly narrower than the earlier approximately 800 pt candidate and is centered in the same 1470 pt window.
claims.unit: pt runtime candidate corroborated by same-scale screenshot
limitations: The screenshot supports reproduction geometry, not equivalence to an official Codex modal reference.

claims.subject: Studio Command Palette internals and backdrop
claims.observation: Input, category, and command rows use a compact vertical rhythm, while the light backdrop preserves more underlying page contrast than the first integration candidate.
limitations: Perceived visual quality and preferred scrim strength remain user acceptance decisions; dark appearance is not captured.

evidence.notes: Packaged, stably signed, installed Happy (dev) selected-conversation state.
Same packaged client and window geometry with Command Palette open.

limitations: Only light appearance is included in this revision gate.
Still screenshots do not prove hover, focus, keyboard traversal, scrolling, or animation quality.
Visual acceptance belongs to the user and is not inferred from tests or this record.

notes: This record documents reproduction truth after parent packaged verification rejected and corrected two earlier wiring candidates.
